parent_objective: materialize medium-v1 matched-budget profile training configs and command matrix without training
blocked_by: M2232 medium design must freeze profiles, seeds, budgets, readiness floors, and claim boundaries

public_gates: M2233 must materialize exactly the M2232 five-profile three-seed medium-v1 matrix
M2233 must set total_steps=32768 for every trainable profile/seed config
M2233 must preserve all other matched budget fields and readiness floors
M2233 must preserve the P0 human-view no-wheel no-oracle actor contract
M2233 must write a training command matrix and claim boundary
M2233 must not run reset, rollout, measured execution, policy action, training, replay, or PPO
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns medium-v1 design into deterministic config and command artifacts
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: config materialization only; no training rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if medium configs differ across profiles beyond profile architecture
stop if generated configs violate actor input contract
stop if materialization starts training or rollout
fallback_plan: route to config repair if materialization fails
route to execution design/run if materialization is clean
route to synthesis if medium training cost is no longer justified

training_stage.stage_objective: materialize no-training medium-v1 matched-budget profile configs
admission_evidence: M2230 complete short-v0 training shows quality_floor_profile_pass_count 0
M2231 audits that as below-floor rather than comparison-ready
M2232 freezes medium-v1 protocol with unchanged profiles, seeds, and readiness floors
allowed_updates: M2233 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by materialization

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2233 materializes configs and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2233.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Materialized configs must support fair finite-window and GRU outcomes without assuming a winner.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: creates deterministic medium-v1 matched-budget training artifacts after short-v0 below-floor result
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: enables the next controlled test of undertraining versus task/curriculum limitations
must_synthesize_if: M2233 cannot materialize equal medium budgets
M2233 would require profile-specific config tuning

hypothesis: M2232 medium-v1 design can be materialized into contract-clean configs and command artifacts without running training.
success_criteria: generated configs exist for each trainable profile and seed
all trained profiles use matched medium budgets and seeds
total_steps is 32768 in every generated config
no reset rollout measured execution training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new rollout or training is performed
decision_rule: M2233 passes if it materializes medium-v1 matched-budget configs and command matrix without training or contract violations.
